item.tib: bdud mo sgrub pa'i lag len
item.coloph: de ltar bdud mo srog sgrub nas kyang*/ mnga' bdag las sogs rin po che/ gshen rab stong rgyung / li mur gtsug phud las sogs brgyud/ bsam yas las sogs gter du sbas/ dus la bab nas las can gcig gyis (gis) bston/ dam tshig can gyis bsgrabs nas kyang / bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog de'i lag len yig chung 'di/ ma tang bdag gis bris par mi 'os te/ sgom chen nan chags che ba'i (bas/)pa pa glan tshig cal col gyi du/ yin ni bsam nas bris pa lags/ nor 'khrul bla ma bder gshegs dang / gter bdag ma mo nyid la bshags/ dge ba bstan pa dar ba dang /bla med bde chen thob par shog rim gyis brgyud nas bdag la zhus snyo//
